body: Device files: mcp.json and settings.json in ~/.cctg/claude, passed by the claude-cctg wrapper (--mcp-config, --settings); ~/.claude/settings.json and ~/.claude.json are never written. Rejected: claude mcp add --scope user (writes ~/.claude.json, leaks the server into every session) and merging hooks into the user settings.

Binary found after an update by a stable absolute path ~/.cctg/bin/cctg[.exe] in every config; install.sh replaces the file in place (Windows: running cctg.exe renamed to cctg.old.exe first, like cctg deploy); running sessions take it via Обновить (shim hand-over), hooks at their next event. Rejected: versioned dirs plus a symlink (Windows symlinks need privileges; the shim already watches one path).
Downloads with curl only (Anthropic native installer needs curl too). Rejected: a wget branch (untestable in CI without hiding curl, no real machine needs it).

Release asset names without the version (cctg-<triple>[.exe]) so install.sh uses releases/latest/download/<asset>; SHA256SUMS checked. Rejected: tag lookup through the GitHub API (rate limit, JSON parsing in sh).

cctg doctor checks the secret with a new authenticated POST /v1/ping on the hook listener (204, 401; 404 from an older hub = reachable, not checked). Rejected: posting a fake hook event, or a hello on the agent link (both make the hub log a warning or act).

Wrapper order: --mcp-config M --dangerously-load-development-channels server:cctg --settings S "$@" (one-value --settings last keeps a prompt argument a prompt). Rejected: --debug-file last as in the manual setup (an unbounded debug log per machine).

Scope: install.sh --hub (Docker compose on a server, secret and cert generated, start checked by the hub log line, client line printed) is in this task; /join in General and --hub --local are proposed as a follow-up. Rejected: all in one task (/join with the shared secret is redone by TASK-045 codes; --local needs an autostart design per OS).

openssl in Git Bash: -subj /CN=cctg-hub is rewritten by MSYS path conversion, and with MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 absolute /tmp paths land in C:	mp. The script runs openssl inside the hub dir with relative paths and MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 only on those two commands.

install.sh e2e is a Rust integration test (tests/install_e2e.rs) that pipes the script into sh / Git Bash like curl | sh, with a local HTTP release server, the real hook endpoint for cctg doctor, and PATH stand-ins for claude, curl (claude.ai only), powershell, docker and cargo. Rejected: a separate shell/bats harness (a second test runner for CI and no access to the real endpoint).

install.sh carries RELEASE=<tag> and downloads releases/download/<tag>/cctg-<tag>-<triple> (035 asset names kept); release.yml refuses a tag whose install.sh differs; --version flag cut. Alternative rejected: unversioned assets + releases/latest (planner): a script fetched from the tag URL (orchestrator decision) would install a newer binary than its own configs.

Windows Git Bash runs install.sh with LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 (C elsewhere): with LC_ALL=C exported, cygpath drops or garbles a Cyrillic USERPROFILE (4 of 6 install_e2e fail with home-Иван). Alternative rejected: no LC_ALL at all (bash 3.2 on macOS uses locale collation in [!-~] ranges).

Ran install_e2e with Git for Windows dash (/usr/bin/dash) as the shell: device tests pass, the --hub test fails because MSYS dash path-converts openssl -subj /CN=... even with MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 exported. Not a target (Windows runs install.sh in Git Bash bash; Linux dash has no path conversion); no change.

install.sh --hub keeps a compose.yml/compose.host.yml changed by hand (other ports per docs/remote-hub.md) and writes the release version as <name>.new. Alternative rejected: overwrite (planner; silently reverts ports, devices lose the hub) and write-once (compose updates never arrive).

docs/remote-hub.md hand-port keeps the TASK-035 fixer's manual chmod +x instructions as a 'Руками' fallback next to the installer text in the device and update bullets. Alternative rejected: reviewer2's hunks verbatim, which would drop the fixer's chmod note.
